brief:
British universities worked together to suppress pro-Palestine activism on their campuses, according to a report cited by Middle East Eye. The coordination among institutions raised concerns about restrictions on student political expression and free speech on university grounds.

The report did not specify which universities were involved or detail the methods used to suppress the activism. It marked a documented instance of institutional cooperation in managing student protest movements related to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
dek: UK universities worked together to suppress pro-Palestine activism, report reveals British universities worked together to suppress pro- Palestine activism on student campuses, a new report has revealed.
title: British universities coordinate crackdown on pro-Palestine student activism
